audit_scope: Academic Research Prototype Validity & Scientific Integrity

items.evidence: UI disclaimers, PDF warning banners, FHIR preliminary status, requires_human_review flag
items.finding: AI-QTriage explicitly disclaims diagnostic authority. Autonomous clinical settlement is strictly blocked whenever models disagree or uncertainty is high.
items.recommended_wording: Academic Research Prototype only; not certified for clinical diagnosis.

items.evidence: Data provenance records in MongoDB and API metadata (data_provenance: SYNTHETIC)
items.finding: Verified: 0 paired clinical multimodal patient records exist in the repository. All training and evaluation data are synthetic simulations.
items.recommended_wording: Evaluated solely on synthetic multimodal simulations; clinical efficacy unproven.

items.evidence: Zero exact-row hash overlap verified across train/val/test splits (Overlap=0). Persistent subject IDs absent.
items.finding: Row-level leakage is zero, but patient-level independence is unproven because synthetic generator lacks persistent subject IDs.
items.recommended_wording: Zero row-level overlap on synthetic split; patient-level independence unproven.

items.evidence: Canonical artifact data/results/vqc_xgb_comparison.json: 25 / 30 correct (83.33% accuracy, macro-F1 0.785)
items.finding: Verified exactly against canonical held-out evaluation artifact (25/30 on 30 test samples).

items.evidence: Canonical artifact data/results/vqc_xgb_comparison.json: 17 / 30 correct (56.67% accuracy, macro-F1 0.421)
items.finding: Verified exactly against canonical held-out evaluation artifact (17/30 on 30 test samples).
items.recommended_wording: 56.67% accuracy on 4-qubit classical simulation; does not outperform XGBoost.

items.evidence: Executed on PennyLane default.qubit classical statevector simulator (4 qubits).
items.finding: No quantum speedup or quantum advantage exists or is claimed. The 4-qubit circuit runs entirely as classical linear algebra.

items.claim: SHAP Explanations as Causal Clinical Drivers
items.evidence: TreeExplainer margin log-odds decomposition callout and waterfall UI subtitles.
items.finding: SHAP represents mathematical attribution of the multi:softprob XGBoost decision margin, NOT physical or biological causality.
items.recommended_wording: TreeExplainer mathematical decision margin decomposition; not biological causality.

items.claim: Evidence Consistency Index (75/100) as Injury Probability
items.finding: The metric is explicitly documented as a deterministic rule-based verification index, NOT a Bayesian probability or clinical certainty.
items.recommended_wording: Deterministic cross-channel verification index (0-100); not a clinical probability.

items.evidence: UI badge Local Demo Simulation, mock delivery outcome in database and API.
items.finding: Verified: no external 911 or real emergency SMS dispatch occurred. Simulated locally.
items.recommended_wording: Simulated emergency workflow demonstration; no real dispatch initiated.
